notes.purpose: User-supplied HD remake pixel-art sheet used directly as render material, not generated art.
notes.lut: Source artwork remains full-colour; semantic LUT channels control world bases, blockers, glows, UI and grading.
notes.generated_blocker_variants: 48 deterministic foliage/rock/mixed/tree variations composited from the user-supplied HD remake sheet; every variation is tagged to the BLOCKERS LUT channel.
notes.world_scale: All HD sprites use a common source-pixel to logical-world scale (0.18) unless an explicit role multiplier is applied.
notes.robot_variants: Eight robot designs × four animation frames cropped from the user-supplied transparent robot sheet.
notes.canopy_occlusion: Large blocking trees render full sprite in static layer and canopy crop again over moths/robots.
notes.robot_animation: 8 supplied robot designs, each with idle/blink/walk_a/walk_b frames; source preserved in assets/robot_variants_source.png.
notes.v39_repack: Runtime atlas repacked from cleaned regions to remove edge bleed / alignment artifacts.
notes.v39_editing: See sprite_sheet_manifest.json and category *_edit_grid.png files for external editing coordinates.
notes.v39_bump: Bump map shares exact runtime atlas coordinates.
notes.v39: V3.9 adds dedicated mini-robot frames, external-editing sprite-sheet references with divider grids/coordinates, foliage expansions and a grayscale bump atlas for future lighting.
notes.v391: 24 unique foliage sprites, 8 unique split large trees, five animated woodland creature families, stronger bump maps, decor vocabulary sanitized.
notes.v391_decor_cleanup: All foliage_extra_* reference fragments are excluded from decor roles; this removes the accidental robot-face / partial-sprite decorations seen in v3.9.
notes.v400_foliage_fx: Physical foliage regions carry explicit FoliageFX category/motion/contact metadata; map files retain placement/clump authority only.

v401_behavior_tuning.flowers_in_pool: excluded as pure standalone sprites; integrated flowering foliage attenuated through metadata profiles

v402_render_audit.moving_foliage_scale: category-aware; short grass +34% height, fern +26%, broad leaf +18%, bush +12%, moss +8%, flowers unchanged
v402_render_audit.sprite_order: world HD quads and foreground scenery are stable-sorted by visual bottom Y before submission
v402_render_audit.tree_trunks: single submission only; canopy remains forced foreground
v402_render_audit.blocker_clipping: eligible tall wall blockers are split exactly between static lower and flat-shaded foreground upper sections
v402_render_audit.bump_edges: normal samples ignore transparent atlas neighbours to suppress edge and split lighting seams

v413_material_maps.method: tree-style broad alpha/luma height + material-aware low-frequency specular atlas
v413_material_maps.runtime: static decoration world material buffers + shared HD specular sampler

v414_material_maps.method: deterministic source-art height + source-space normal + unassociated specular
